[EN] Confidence is contagious. That's good. Complacency is also contagious. That's terrible.

I believe you'll have to speak to a badge merchant or a talent agent, to find what you're seeking.
[ES] La confianza es contagiosa. Eso es bueno. La autocomplacencia también es contagiosa. Eso es terrible.

Creo que tendrás que hablar con un comerciante de insignias o un agente de talentos para encontrar lo que buscas.
